paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
notes: Projection (sensitivity forecast) for a proposed SiN membrane-Be mirror optomechanical accelerometer searching for vector B-L dark photon dark matter. The paper's main exclusion plot (Fig. 2) is gB-L vs mDM in the range ~1e-12 to 1e-10 eV. Data points are approximate reads from Fig. 2 (blue/dashed curves for 1-year and coherence-time scans) and are rough estimates since no numerical table is provided. The stated aim is to exceed Eot-Wash bound (g<~1e-22 for wDM<2pi*10kHz). Fig. 4 shows a corresponding B-coupled projection (different coupling channel). Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
